```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Ruby
      uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
      with:
        ruby-version: '3.0'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        bundle install --path vendor/bundle

    - name: Run PCRE version detection script
      run: |
        ./scripts/detect_pcre_version.sh

    - name: Update package selection logic
      run: |
        sed -i 's|pcre|pcre2|g' recipes/default.rb

    - name: Add unit tests
      run: |
        bundle exec rake spec

    - name: Update CI configuration
      run: |
        sed -i 's|pcrerequire|pcre2require|g' .travis.yml

    - name: Update documentation
      run: |
        sed -i 's|PCRE|PCRE2|g' README.md

    - name: Fix platform logic per maintainer feedback
      run: |
        sed -i 's|if node[:platform_version].to_i < 10|if node[:platform_version].to_i >= 10|g' recipes/default.rb

    - name: Fix rspec test failures
      run: |
        bundle exec rake spec

    - name: Revert to correct PCRE logic
      run: |
        git checkout HEAD^ recipes/default.rb
        git commit -m "Revert to correct PCRE logic"
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up a pipeline to perform various tasks related to fixing PCRE version detection based on platform version in the `sous-chefs/haproxy` repository. The workflow includes steps for checking out the repository, setting up Ruby, installing dependencies, running a PCRE version detection script, updating package selection logic, adding unit tests, updating CI configuration, updating documentation, fixing platform logic per maintainer feedback, fixing rspec test failures, and reverting to the correct PCRE logic.
